title: No Trace: Private Code Chat
fullDescription:
Encrypted code-based chat. No phone. No email. No account.

Share an 8-character code with someone. They type it in. You are talking. End-to-end encrypted from your device. Nothing to log in to. Nothing to back up.

WHY NO TRACE WORKS

• No phone number — no SMS confirmation that fails in your country. You install, you chat.
• No email — no recovery flow you have to remember.
• No account — no profile, no friend list, no directory.
• 8-character code — share on paper, by voice, by QR. Whoever has the code joins. Whoever does not, never sees the room.
• Optional 2-layer code — share a room without leaking access. The join-code is the second gate.
• Three privacy presets — Ghost saves nothing on your phone, Balanced keeps codes for one-tap re-open, Comfort keeps history too. Change anytime.
• Screen-recording lock — your chats render as black in screen recorders.
• App lock — optional tap-code on every launch.
• 1-tap delete all data — Settings > Account > Delete. Nothing kept on our side.

HOW IT IS DIFFERENT

Signal needs a phone number. Telegram needs a phone number. WhatsApp needs a phone number. Threema gives you a permanent ID that lives forever. No Trace gives you a throwaway 8-character code per room — no identity follows you.

WHO PICKS IT

• Journalists collecting tips
• Lawyers and doctors with confidentiality duties
• Activists and advocates
• Two people who want a chat that does not sit in either phone's backup
• Teams who want a side channel separate from work tools

CROSS-DEVICE

Android, iPhone, iPad, Web, macOS, Linux. Open the room on whatever you have nearest.

PRIVACY YOU CAN VERIFY

• No ads
• Tracking limited to crash + basic analytics, disclosed in our data safety section
• Premium uses Google Play billing only — no external payment links
• Delete all your data anytime: Settings > Account > Delete

FEATURES

• 1:1 and small-group code-gated rooms
• Featured Topics — anonymous public rooms with daily prompts
• Reply-to threading + emoji reactions
• Edit and delete your own messages
• Report and block any sender
• Long-press copy
• QR share for in-person joins
• Deep links — notrace://chat/CODE
• Three privacy levels you control

PRICING

50 free messages on install. Premium is a one-time purchase — lifetime unlimited messages. No subscriptions. No recurring charges. No renewal.

Install No Trace. Create a room. Share the code. That is the whole onboarding.
shortDescription: Anonymous chat by 8-char code. No phone, no email, no account. Encrypted.
